name: Necromancer: Foul Invocation refuses mounting and keeps the form (#10601)
contract: Foul Invocation (804371) is a native SPELL_AURA_TRANSFORM into creature 444914, shown as display 310061
while its aura is active. A Brown Horse (458) cast submitted in that form must be refused with the native
transform rejection SPELL_FAILED_NOT_SHAPESHIFT (68): the transform-specific gate in Spell::CheckCast reads
getTransForm() and rejects a transforming spell that carries SPELL_ATTR0_NO_IMMUNITIES and is neither
ALLOW_WHILE_MOUNTED nor a debuff. The mount aura and mount display must stay absent, the Foul Invocation
aura and display 310061 must remain, distinguishing rejection from the reported mounted form and from a
mount-then-cancel-form behavior. Once the form is removed, the same ordinary on-foot Brown Horse cast must
succeed, proving the fixture and the ordinary mount path remain valid.
Evidence boundary: this observes native aura, display, cast-failure and mount state in a socketless
session. It does not cover rendered client appearance, animations or mount speed.

steps.label: Let login settle
Riding skill for the mount
Learn the mount and the form so neither cast can fail on a missing spellbook entry
Enter Foul Invocation
SETUP: the Foul Invocation aura is active
SETUP: the transform display is shown
Clear the form cast's global cooldown
Try to mount the Brown Horse while transformed
DISCRIMINATING: the mount cast is refused with SPELL_FAILED_NOT_SHAPESHIFT
DISCRIMINATING: no mount aura was applied
DISCRIMINATING: no mount display was set
DISCRIMINATING: the form aura survived the refused mount
DISCRIMINATING: the transform display is retained
CONTROL: leave Foul Invocation
CONTROL: the form is gone
Clear any remaining global cooldown
CONTROL: mount the Brown Horse on foot
CONTROL: the on-foot mount cast is accepted
CONTROL: the mount aura is applied
CONTROL: the mount display is set
Restore the native state
The control dismounts
